integrity: Full finite Morse acyclicity, six integral boundary certificates, and exact Smith forms were generated and checked; no external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed seven-element ground set only; exact integral homology does not determine homotopy type; no claim for larger Kneser parameters; equivalent unindexed computation remains a literature risk.
title: Torsion-free integral homology for the first nontrivial triple Kneser independence complex
